summary: The proof is mathematically complete. Corollary 8 of the cited paper specializes at n=k=2 to K=conv(-z/2+D,z), with D a nondegenerate segment parallel to the centroidal cutting line, so the equality rigidity and cap orientation are exact. The Hausdorff-continuity, John normalization, height shear, uniform bounds, degenerate endpoint limit, and triangle limits are all justified. The limiting-certificate argument correctly uses the whole-plane cover and the 4/9 cap bound to force every limiting halfplane through the centroid, excludes one- or two-cap neighborhood covers and repetitions, and hence obtains exactly the three centroidal edge-parallel vertex caps. The rectangle example has the stated area, containment, compatibility, and nondegenerate segment limit.
